description: Graphite drawing of a canyon with two plateaus on each side in the foreground. There is a hill and another plateau in the foreground. On the canyon floor are bumps that appear to be plants. This artwork has *Untitled (Palo Duro Canyon)*, 1916–1917 (cat. no. 161) on the back.
title: Untitled (Palo Duro Canyon)
